blocks.title: Algorithm
blocks.text: Algorithms are step-by-step procedures for solving problems, much like a recipe gives the steps for cooking a dish.

Algorithms are the backbone of computer science: they provide the logic behind software, letting us solve complex problems, optimize performance and ensure accuracy. Google's search engine uses an algorithm called PageRank that considers the number and quality of links to a page to rank search results (Did You Know). When learning algorithms, relate them to real-life tasks you already know (Tip).

blocks.prompt: Why is a recipe a good model of an algorithm?
blocks.explanation: It is a finite list of clear steps in order that turns given inputs (ingredients) into a result (the dish).

items: Algorithm: a step-by-step procedure, like a recipe; PageRank ranks web pages by links.
